tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Summarize the available AI Incident Law dataset buckets and record counts.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: List compact AI incident law records, optionally filtered by dataset, domain, type, jurisdiction, status, source quality, or review flag.

dataset.description: Dataset bucket, such as included, review, or global.

error_type.description: Error or event type substring filter.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction, country, or authority substring filter.

filing_status.description: Outcome or procedural posture substring filter.

needs_review.description: Review flag, usually yes or no.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get one full AI Incident Law source record by error_id or candidate_id.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search across record titles, descriptions, parties, jurisdictions, tags, and source metadata.

tools.name: get_staleness_report
tools.description: Report record verification decay: records ranked oldest-verified first, with per-bucket counts. Use to find matters overdue for re-verification before relying on them.

dataset.description: Optional dataset bucket filter, such as included, review, or global.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to age records against. When omitted, days_stale is not computed and records are returned sorted by verification date only.

tools.name: list_authorities
tools.description: List Obligation-First authority records generated from included public matters. Schema: https://obligationfirst.org/; context: https://obligationfirst.org/v1/context.jsonld.

tools.name: get_authority
tools.description: Get a generated Obligation-First authority record by authority ID, not a source matter ID. Schema: https://obligationfirst.org/; context: https://obligationfirst.org/v1/context.jsonld.

tools.name: get_obligation_first_record
tools.description: Get a generated Obligation-First authority, proceeding, allegation, determination, or tombstone record by kind and graph ID. Schema: https://obligationfirst.org/; context: https://obligationfirst.org/v1/context.jsonld. A proceeding or allegation does not establish a determination.

kind.description: Record kind: authorities, proceedings, allegations, determinations, or tombstones.

limitations: This snapshot describes the exact published npm 0.4.2 tarball, including the assistant guide bytes that it contains.
Registry metadata and one local stdio initialization were observed; no hosted runtime or provider action was exercised.
